views.name: paper_author_link
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  writes.paperId AS paperId,
  author.authorId AS authorId,
  author.authorName AS authorName
FROM writes
JOIN author ON writes.authorId = author.authorId
JOIN paper ON writes.paperId = paper.paperId
views.description: One row per (paper, author) link showing paper and author identifiers and names to enable co-authorship and author-based filtering.
validated_on: Can you provide the distinct paper IDs, publication years, and impact categories for papers published from 2010 onwards in recognized journals that were co-authored by both Peter Mertens and Dina Barbian, where papers with more than 50 citations are considered "High Impact" and those with fewer are considered "Low Impact"?

views.name: paper_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT

  paper.venueId AS venueId,

views.name: paper_coauthors_agg
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pal.paperId AS paperId,
  COUNT(DISTINCT pal.authorId) AS author_count,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT pal.authorId) AS author_ids_concat
FROM paper_author_link pal
GROUP BY pal.paperId
views.description: For each paper, aggregated list/count of its authors and a deduplicated count of distinct authorIds to enable co-author existence checks and author-count filters.

views.name: paper_core_3
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.paperId AS paperId,
  p.title AS title,
  p.year AS year,
  COALESCE(p.numCiting, 0) AS numCiting,
  p.journalId AS journalId,
  p.venueId AS venueId,
  COALESCE(p.numCitedBy, 0) AS numCitedBy
FROM paper p
views.description: One row per paper with its core metadata normalized/cleaned for downstream filtering and classification.

views.name: paper_authors_agg

SELECT

  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT pal.authorName) AS author_names_concat
FROM paper_author_link pal
GROUP BY pal.paperId
views.description: Aggregated view listing authors (by id and name) per paper as a set-like collection to enable fast co-author existence checks and counts.

views.description: Cohort view of authors for each paper exposing the paper id and the canonicalized author name (trimmed/lowercased) to support name-based filtering and grouping.

views.name: paper_authorships
views.body_sql:
SELECT pal.paperId,
       pal.authorId,
       pal.authorName,
       pc3.title,
       pc3.year,
       pc3.venueId,
       pc3.journalId,
       pc3.numCiting,
       pc3.numCitedBy
FROM paper_author_link AS pal
JOIN paper_core_3 AS pc3 USING(paperId)
views.description: One row per paper-author pairing, with paper, author, and basic paper attributes. Useful to filter papers by which authors wrote them and to join paper metadata to authorship rows.
validated_on: Which scholarly works have emerged from the collaborative efforts involving Peter Mertens, are interlinked through other contributors, and are expressly associated with Dina Barbian?

views.name: paper_authors_list
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.paperId AS paperId,
  COUNT(w.authorId) AS author_count,
  GROUP_CONCAT(a.authorName, ', ') AS authors_concat
FROM paper p
LEFT JOIN writes w ON p.paperId = w.paperId
LEFT JOIN author a ON w.authorId = a.authorId
GROUP BY p.paperId
views.description: One row per paper with an aggregated list of its author names and count of authors. Useful to quickly test co-authorship conditions and to find papers that include particular author combinations.
validated_on: Which research work does Peter Mertens and Dina Barbian collaboratively contribute to, that started gaining attention after the millennium, and how significant is their impact in the scholarly environment?

views.name: paper_coauthor_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.paperId AS paperId,
  p.title AS title,
  COUNT(DISTINCT w.authorId) AS num_authors,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT w.authorId) AS author_ids_list
FROM paper p
LEFT JOIN writes w ON p.paperId = w.paperId
GROUP BY p.paperId, p.title
views.description: Per paper counts and lists of distinct authors to identify papers that have multiple authors and to support checks for presence of specific authors.

views.name: author_paper_network_edges
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p1.paperId,
  p1.authorId AS authorId_a,
  p1.authorName AS authorName_a,
  p2.authorId AS authorId_b,
  p2.authorName AS authorName_b
FROM paper_author_link p1
JOIN paper_author_link p2
  ON p1.paperId = p2.paperId
WHERE p1.authorId < p2.authorId
views.description: Author-to-author coauthorship edges derived from shared papers: one row per pair of coauthors with the paper that connects them. Useful for building collaboration networks and finding connected components or neighbors.

views.name: paper_citation_level
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.paperId AS paperId,
  p.numCitedBy AS numCitedBy,
  CASE
    WHEN p.numCitedBy IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE NULL
  END AS citation_level
FROM paper p
views.description: Assigns a citation level label to each paper based on its raw numCitedBy value. Keeps one row per paper with the raw measure and a categorical label; thresholds are not hard-coded here and should be applied in question_ops or calling query.

views.name: venue_paper_link
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.paperId AS paperId,
  v.venueId AS venueId,
  v.venueName AS venueName
FROM paper p
JOIN venue v ON p.venueId = v.venueId
WHERE p.venueId IS NOT NULL
views.description: Denormalized one-row-per-paper-with-its-venue combining paper and venue names. Exposes venue identifiers and names alongside paper identifiers for easy grouping and filtering by venue.

views.name: papers_per_venue_agg
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  v.venueId AS venueId,
  v.venueName AS venueName,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.paperId) AS paper_count_raw
FROM venue v
LEFT JOIN paper p ON p.venueId = v.venueId
WHERE p.venueId IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY v.venueId, v.venueName
views.description: Aggregate count of distinct papers per venue (one row per venue). Precomputes the raw count measure to speed repeated per-venue queries. Keeps venueId and venueName as grouping keys.

views.name: paper_venue
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.paperId AS paperId,
  p.title AS title,
  p.year AS year,
  v.venueId AS venueId,
  v.venueName AS venueName,
  p.numCitedBy AS numCitedBy,
  p.numCiting AS numCiting
FROM paper p
LEFT JOIN venue v ON p.venueId = v.venueId
views.description: Denormalized relation joining papers to their venues (only one row per paper) exposing venue name for filtering and display. Keeps papers even if venueName is empty/null depending on filter applied later.

views.name: paper_author_membership
views.body_sql:
SELECT w.paperId AS paperId,
       a.authorId AS authorId,
       a.authorName AS authorName
FROM writes w
JOIN author a ON w.authorId = a.authorId
views.description: Mapping of which authors wrote which papers (one row per paper-author pair) including author name to enable existence checks of specific authors on a paper.
validated_on: What is the average number of companions on the scholarly voyage for each paper where Peter Mertens is the captain, but not counted among his crew?

views.name: author_by_name
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  author.authorId AS authorId,
  author.authorName AS authorName
FROM author
views.description: Normalized author lookup rows keyed by authorId with canonical authorName; useful for resolving author ids from exact name matches.

views.name: paper_dataset_links
views.body_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  pd.paperId AS paperId,
  pd.datasetId AS datasetId
FROM paperDataset pd
JOIN dataset d ON d.datasetId = pd.datasetId
JOIN paper p ON p.paperId = pd.paperId
views.description: One row per association between a paper and a dataset, canonicalized so each (paperId,datasetId) pair appears once.

views.name: paper_dataset_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.paperId,
  COUNT(DISTINCT pd.datasetId) AS distinct_dataset_count
FROM paper p
LEFT JOIN paperDataset pd ON p.paperId = pd.paperId
GROUP BY p.paperId

semantic_filters.exclude_no_datasets: optional; do not exclude by default (callers may filter distinct_dataset_count > 0)

views.description: Per paper counts of distinct datasets associated with that paper (one row per paper). Exposes the raw count measure so callers can filter or aggregate further.

views.name: paper_author_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.paperId AS paperId,
  COUNT(DISTINCT w.authorId) AS num_distinct_authors
FROM paper p
LEFT JOIN writes w ON p.paperId = w.paperId
GROUP BY p.paperId
views.description: Aggregated counts of distinct authors per paper. One row per paper with the number of distinct authors associated with that paper. Keep raw counts so downstream queries can subtract or filter specific authors.

views.name: author_canonical
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  a.authorId AS authorId,
  lower(trim(a.authorName)) AS authorName_canonical
FROM author AS a
views.description: One row per author with canonicalized name and author id for joins and filters.

views.name: papers_with_metadata
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.paperId,
  p.title,
  p.venueId,
  p.journalId,
  p.year,
  p.numCiting,
  p.numCitedBy,
  wa.authorId
FROM paper p
JOIN writes wa ON wa.paperId = p.paperId
views.description: Paper-level metadata including venue and journal links. One row per paper.

views.name: paper_coauthors_aggregate
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  w.paperId AS paperId,
  COUNT(DISTINCT w.authorId) AS num_authors,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT a.authorName) AS author_names_concat
FROM writes w
LEFT JOIN author a ON a.authorId = w.authorId
GROUP BY w.paperId
views.description: Aggregated co-author list per paper: for each paperId, exposes number of distinct authors and a concatenated list (or array) of authorNames to support co-author existence checks and counts.

views.name: keyphrase_row
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  keyphrase.keyphraseId AS keyphraseId,
  keyphrase.keyphraseName AS keyphraseName
FROM keyphrase
views.description: Canonical keyphrase rows with id and normalized name (one row per keyphrase).

views.name: paper_keyphrase_link
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  paperKeyphrase.paperId AS paperId,
  paperKeyphrase.keyphraseId AS keyphraseId
FROM paperKeyphrase
WHERE paperKeyphrase.paperId IS NOT NULL
views.description: Row-level association between a paper and a keyphrase (one row per paper-keyphrase link). Exposes raw ids for counting distinct papers per keyphrase.

views.name: keyphrase_paper_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pk.keyphraseId AS keyphraseId,
  COUNT(DISTINCT pk.paperId) AS paper_count
FROM paperKeyphrase pk
GROUP BY pk.keyphraseId
views.description: Aggregate counts of distinct papers per keyphraseId (one row per keyphrase), computed from paper-keyphrase links.
